page.layout: One printed page (right-hand page of an opening) with running text in one main column; a narrow column of marginal notes runs down its right side, partly cut by the binding edge. Page number at top left, running head centred at top.

main_text.p: ὤφελον. praes.pass. ὀφείλομαι. part. ὀφειλόμενος η ον debitus a um, 1.Cor.7.3. praet.pass. ὠφεί-λημαι unde est
᾿Οφελεῖα, ας τὸ utilitas. ab ὀφέλλω juvo, augeo.
᾿Οφθαλμός, οῦ ὁ oculus, ab ὄπτομαι video.
᾿Οφθαλμοδουλεία, ας ἡ obsequium ad oculos exhibitum, augendienst. ὀφθαλμοδούλος, ου ὁ ein augendiener/ servus qui inspectante hero segnavum praestat, Eph.6.6.
᾿Οφις, εως ὁ serpens. Accus. ὄφιν. ὄφις ἀρχαῖος, serpens antiquus, h.e. diabolus.
᾿Οφρὺς, ύος ἡ supercilium. per metaph. montis extremitas seu crepido unde quis praeceps agi potest. Alii vertunt, cacumen. Syrus vertit, gibbum montis.

᾿Οχλος, ου ὁ turba, populus, multitudo, Matth. 21.8. ὄχλος ἐστρώννυον, populus straverunt. Sic Joh.7.49. ὄχλος ἐπικατάρατος, populus maledictus, anomalia numeri elegans. coetus Luc.6.17. ὄχλος μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ, coetus discipulorum ejus. tumultus Luc.22.6. ἄτερ ὄχλου, absq; tumultu.
᾿Οχλέω ῶ turbo. Fut. ἡσω. P. ὠχλήθην. praes.pass. ὀχλέομαι ἡμαι vexor.
᾿Οχλοποιέω ῶ cogo turbam. F. ἡσω. P. ὠχλοποιήθην. aor.1. ὠχλοποίησα.
᾿Οχύρωμα, ατος τὸ munitio, ab ὀχυρόω ῶ munio, quod

page.notes: Marginal notes on the right edge are cut off and partly illegible (fragments such as "quod est anomine", "idem valet quod", "pluvia jacientis", "dabatur loco", "pro salario"); they are not transcribed in full. The Greek is transcribed from the scan with some uncertainty in accents and breathings. Page 334 is the right-hand page; the left page is not visible.
